extraction.Name: Benjamin Decory
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by C. L. Dice on April 9, 1920
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: conveyed by deed from Benjamin Decory to W. H. Whitcher for a consideration of $3400.00
extraction.Buyer: W. H. Whitcher for a consideration of $3400.00
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 739603 issued; Southeast quarter of Section 18, township 38, range 28; receipt for patent signed by the allottee on April 3, 1920; deed recorded on September 10, 1920

extraction.Name: David Whiting
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: The land was mortgaged five times and conveyed by deed signed by David and Phoebe Whiting on March 3, 1921, to William J. Whitcher for $10,000
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612742 issued; The northwest quarter of the southeast quarter and the northeast quarter of the southwest quarter of section 1, township 33, range 12, in Nebraska; receipt for patent signed by the allottee in February, 1918; deed also signed by Phoebe Whiting (wife); land was mortgaged five times before conveyance
